_source_note: Real, per-institution, per-programme cutoff data, uploaded by the user as two spreadsheets and transcribed verbatim - not estimated or generated. University of Ghana rows come from UG's own official admissions page (confidence: official_institution_source); KNUST rows come from a third-party site, not KNUST's own release (confidence: third_party_source) - treat KNUST figures as less certain than UG's.
_coverage_note: Only University of Ghana and KNUST have per-programme data so far. Every other institution in programmes.json's institutions_example lists (UCC, UEW, UDS, UHAS, UENR, UMaT, CKT-UTAS, SDD-UBIDS, UPSA, GIMPA, GCTU, UniMAC, AAMUSTED, the 10 Technical Universities, and any private university) has NO per-programme row here yet - a lookup for them should say so plainly, never fall back to a category-level guess presented as institution-specific.
_cutoff_field_note: cutoff_display preserves the source cell exactly, including UG's parenthetical values (e.g. '7(8)', '16(24)M') which the source itself doesn't fully explain row-by-row - cutoff_primary is the first number only (best-effort, for sorting/filtering), cutoff_alt the parenthetical number if present, cutoff_flag any trailing letter (e.g. 'M'). Always show cutoff_display to the student, not just cutoff_primary, since the alt value and flag can matter (see the Family and Consumer Sciences row's own 'affirmative action for males' note for an example of why).
